test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 09 Dec 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
In the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions based on those statements. Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion logically follows the given statements.

**Statements:**

I. All R are H.

II. Some T are R.

**Conclusion:**

I. All H are R.

II. All T are H.

III. No R is T.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follows

solution:
Statements:
I. All R are H.
II. Some T are R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/96af13b97fd1b5030f9735a95953b8a912800880c5c48781af2d5f8e93438f1c.png] 
Conclusions:
I. All H are R → Does not follow → Since 'All R are H' that means All H are R is a possibility not necessity so conclusion does not follow
II. All T are H → Does not follow → Since 'All R are H' & Some T are R. that also means 'All T are H' is a possibility not necessity so conclusion does not follow
III. No R is T → Does not follow → Since 'Some T are R'. that also means Some part of R lies in T so conclusion does not follow.

Hence, **Neither conclusion follows.**
